title: EvalResults
description: The release record (S1, B40/D4): E7/N3's 'every release records its eval results' had no carrier, and the eval_pass_state metric names an eval_results stream nothing produced. `engine eval` writes this file under docs/releases/<engine_version>/ on every run and exits nonzero when a blocking bar is unmet; COMMITTING it is the deliberate release act (B34(29) siting — the record is evidence, and the clause-6 run logs attach beside it in the same directory). Promotion, pre-production reading: the record exists and eval_pass_state is true for this engine_version (closer for real environments: A5/A6). Every lane declares its measurement basis honestly (B40/D10) — this record never states a live number nobody measured.

engine_version.description: A release is a commit (N3): engine/version.py's 0.1.0+<short-sha>, so a record naming one is reproducible.

mode.description: Eval runs are bench runs even when live-called — eval dollars and eval records never enter a production series (O3, B34(16)).

hold_constant.description: The comparability keys (R11, metric-definition.hold_constant) — two records are comparable only when these match; the reporting layer segments at these boundaries and never averages across them silently.

model_pins.description: Tier -> exact model id (N5: full eval re-run on any model change).

prompt_version.description: Formally aliased to config_digest (B40/D5) — a second carrier would be a second source of truth; the alias is stated here, not hidden.

judge_model.description: null until a judge is calibrated (A4) — never a placeholder id nobody ran.

rate_card_version.description: synthetic-v0 until A1 (B40/D14) — a rate change must read as a rate change, never a cost movement.

suites.description: One entry per eval lane, keyed by suite name (poison, extraction, injection, anonymization, mapper, structure, voice, intake, consistency, drafter, red_team, trajectory, ...). The measured numbers live under `measures` and the declared bars under `bar` — scalar per metric (B11: compound bars are one case per metric, each with its own scalar bar).

basis.description: How the numbers were obtained (B40/D10): deterministic = measured fresh offline, real numbers; scripted = harness proven with scripted math, the model half unmeasured; live_baseline = read from a recorded live baseline behind fingerprint checks.

status.description: baseline_stale = the dual fingerprint refused a comparison (prompts or cases moved since the recorded measure) — the honest state after an un-re-baselined prompt edit, never silently 'pass'.

blocking.description: true = failing this suite blocks release with no waiver path (fabricated-Tier-1 recall, anonymization recall — E2/E4).

advisory.description: true = reported, never gated (red_team per B34(9)); a spread or an uncalibrated judge score must not gate (v1 metric-contract lesson).

measures.description: The suite's numbers as measured — recall/precision/n, per-family tables, boolean results. Free-shape by design: the lane's meaning lives in its harness; the record carries what was measured.

bar.description: The declared bar(s), scalar per named metric (e.g. {"recall": 0.98, "precision": 0.85} or {"family_floor": 0.75, "benign_false_positives": 0}).

fingerprints.description: The drift locks the numbers stand behind (prompts_fingerprint, cases_fingerprint, lexicon_fingerprint, spec_fingerprint).

gates.description: The six release-gate clauses (EVAL_SUITE promotion criteria, E7). Failing clause 1 blocks; clauses 2-4 fail only past a named owner's written override (in `overrides`); clauses evaluated by a phase that has not run yet carry not_performed + their closer — visibly, never silently omitted.

detail.description: For fail: which bar, measured vs required — the record names what blocked, never a bare red.

closer.description: For not_performed: the phase that makes this clause evaluable (A3 replay, A4 judge calibration).

judge_calibration.description: Gate 5's input, carried explicitly (B40/G-J): not_performed with its closer beats silent omission — a promotion gate that cannot be evaluated must say so on the record.

blocking_failures.description: suite.metric names ('poison.recall') for every unmet blocking bar — the exit-nonzero reasons, enumerable by a caller without re-deriving.

overrides.description: E7's named-owner written overrides for gate clauses 2-4 (never clause 1 — no waiver path). Empty is the normal state.

eval_pass_state.description: The metric of the same name resolves from this field: true iff no blocking failure and every evaluable gate passes (not_performed gates carry their closer and do not fail the state pre-production — the narrowing is logged in B40/D4).
